name: intraday-equities-p7-extratrees-h02
notes: P7 shortlist cell: a feature row every 5 minute(s), a look-ahead of 2 minute(s), extremely randomized trees, 300 of them averaged. One of nineteen cells that differ from the P1 s05 grid in exactly ONE place - the scan's estimator block (estimator, estimator_params and the purged search over it, ADR-0060). The row spacing, the look-ahead, the features, the folds, the label, the cohort, the store, the study start and the 30-minute scoring lattice are byte-for-byte the values run-p1-s05-h02-ridge.json carries, so a P7 cell is read straight against its P1 twin at the same look-ahead and only the model differs (ADR-0065). Every P7 cell also gets the SAME purged inner-holdout search on the SAME objective, which is the unfairness docs/research/p7-model-size-for-this-noise-level-*.md found: ridge and the trees were each searched, the three nets were not, so 'bigger is worse' was partly a statement about tuning effort. Scored under ADR-0067 and raised to ADR-0069's many-attempts bar - nineteen more cells raise that bar for everything, which is the price of the shortlist. Reads nothing at or after 2026-03-01.

universe.notes: The H<=20 grid variant, with the row spacing overridden to 5 minute(s) for this cell (ADR-0065). The cohort, calendar and holdout dates stay exactly the shared ones.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted historical SIP tape (source alpaca-sip-split, ADR-0063): AAPL's 2020 4-for-1, WMT's 2024 3-for-1 and the XLE/XLK 2-for-1s of December 2025 are all removed by the vendor, so no change of unit reads as a price move. start_ms is the study's start date, 2018-01-01 (ADR-0066) - it precedes the earliest bar any fold reads by 2y4m, and it puts XLF's 2016-09-19 XLRE spin-off, the one corporate action the vendor does NOT adjust, outside the readable window. Prices here are NOT the as-traded scale and are not comparable with any number recorded before 2026-09-03. Run from the child root.

scan.notes: P7 item 2, the cheapest honest test of averaging: 300 shallow trees, each grown on a random 30% of the columns at random split points, and their plain equal-weight average. The combination literature says the equal-weight average wins here precisely because it estimates no weights - the gain is variance reduction, which is nearly the whole error when the signal is this small. Extra trees come first because the extra randomisation makes each member weaker and the average lower variance than a bootstrap forest's. No column scaling is needed, which is why this arrives without a pipeline. n_jobs 4 is a thread count, not a model knob, and is held at 4 rather than 8 because a forest fit holds one float32 copy of the design matrix per worker. Everything outside estimator/estimator_params/hpo_* is the P1 s05 cell verbatim: split val, the fold's own cuts, label_scale vol, label_residual SPY, lead_start=lead_step=lead_stop=2 (ADR-0062: lead_start is also the training label, so this cell trains and scores at 2 minute(s) and nowhere else), and score_period_ms 1800000 so only validation rows on the half-hour are judged and the Newey-West lag comes from the lattice, not the spacing (ADR-0065). The search is the P1 ridge cell's: 6 draws on a 63-day inner holdout carved out of train with a 5-day embargo, chosen on IC, the fold's own validation never read.

names.notes: All five tradables. AAPL and WMT were excluded while the tape carried unadjusted splits; the split-adjusted store (ADR-0063) removed that reason, so the cohort that builds the features and the cohort that gets SCORED are the same five again. Sits after tradable so a later run can narrow what is scored without touching what is built.

walkforward.notes: Same post-COVID folds as run-hstar-cv-postcovid.json so the two are comparable: first validation 2022-05-06, twenty 63-day steps, a real 730-day bounded training window, last validation inside the 2025-11-30 cut. objective is val_ic, NOT go_frac: counting fold-level rejections and taking the max is vote counting, which Hedges-Olkin showed is inconsistent when per-fold power is below one half (A0035). The winner here only labels a fold in the summary; the science is the per-fold sequence, which is what the block-by-block reading needs. embargo_days=5 is now larger than any label window on this grid (20 minutes), so no training row's label can reach into validation.
